svg.title: Experimental datasets and insertion libraries across evolution
svg.desc: Experimental datasets in panel A; vertically aligned ancestral and evolved backgrounds and matched-size bunched insertion libraries in panel B. Enlarged quantitative fitness indicators retain the original values and colors. Panel C is reserved.

C — Local fitness landscapes along evolution
g.title: Repeated sampling of transposon neighborhoods along evolutionary trajectories
g.desc: Conceptual fitness contours with two evolutionary trajectories from a common ancestor. At successive sampled backgrounds, radial transposon mutants have background-dependent fitness effects. Colors illustrate effects, not measured data.

text.tspan: Insertion libraries sample the local fitness landscape
